action: check git ls-files for every file the script reads, reassemble in scratch with the paths substituted and compare per-file hashes with the manifest, and rerun the committed source to compare outputs byte for byte; a manifest that hashes a file does not mean the file is committed
trigger: a lane's build script or BUILD_MANIFEST names a lockfile, a source copy or an absolute worktree path
why: descent-finder mini-build: build.sh copies an uncommitted Cargo.lock under set -e and hard-codes an absent worktree; BUILD_MANIFEST hashes neither the compiled traced_descent_check.rs nor commits the lock; path-substituted reassembly and an offline lock reproduced every hash and the outputs
